meta.name: LinkPass On-Premises Deployment & Packaging Specification
meta.author: David Idemudia Odigie (LinkPass / AssetPulse)
meta.description: Defines the standard architectural requirements, packaging bundles, security constraints, and operational workflows for deploying LinkPass in isolated on-premises enterprise environments.

core_principles: Zero-Knowledge First: Server never handles unencrypted client secrets or private key material.
Air-Gapped Autonomy: Zero external internet dependencies; license verification must operate completely offline using asymmetric RSA public-key signatures.
Containerized Portability: Single-command deployment using Docker Compose across Linux distributions (Ubuntu, RHEL, Rocky, AlmaLinux).
Strict Governance & Quorum: High-stakes operations (such as full vault export) require multi-admin TOTP quorum approvals.
SIEM-Ready Auditing: All access, view, copy, and export attempts must be recorded in an immutable 90-day retention log.

contents: server/ (FastAPI backend source code, routers, middleware)
server/license_pub.pem (Production RSA Public Key for JWT license verification)
server/certs/ (SSL/TLS self-signed or enterprise CA certificates)
docker-compose.yml (Orchestration with SQLite default & PostgreSQL HA toggle)
bundles.installation_method: Unpack zip -> Place license.jwt in server/ -> Run docker compose up --build -d

contents: LinkPass.exe (Standalone PyInstaller executable, zero runtime installation required)
cacert.pem (Custom enterprise TLS trust bundle if using internal CA)
bundles.installation_method: Uncompress -> Edit config.json with server IP -> Run LinkPass.exe

contents: KeyGen/main.py (Tkinter GUI tool for license creation)
bundles.installation_method: Run main.py on secure admin workstation -> Generate client `.lic` files

tier_1_standard.use_case: Small to Medium Enterprises (Up to 500 users, single server node)

tier_2_enterprise_ha.use_case: Large Enterprise Clusters / High Availability Load Balanced Setups

networking_and_firewall.airgap_compliance: 100% Offline. Zero outbound connections to external public internet endpoints.

licensing_verification.middleware_enforcement: Every incoming API call evaluates license status (validity, expiration, signature verification). Returns 403 Forbidden on expired or tampered license.

zero_knowledge_model.master_key: Derived client-side via Argon2id / PBKDF2. Never sent to or stored on server.

authentication.mfa: Mandatory TOTP (RFC 6238) seed required on every login
authentication.first_boot_bootstrap: Initial deployment generates admin account with console-logged TOTP seed.

initial_deployment: 1. Transfer LinkPass-Linux-Server.zip to target Linux server via SCP/SFTP.
2. Extract bundle: unzip LinkPass-Linux-Server.zip -d LinkPass && cd LinkPass.
3. Generate customer `.lic` via KeyGen GUI tool and copy to LinkPass/server/license.jwt.
4. Update JWT secret in docker-compose.yml (or create .env file).
5. Spin up container: sudo docker compose up --build -d.
6. Retrieve initial superadmin TOTP seed from logs: sudo docker compose logs server.
7. Open port 443 on host firewall (ufw / firewalld).
8. Distribute LinkPass-Client.zip to workstations with updated config.json.
license_renewal: 1. Generate new `.lic` file via KeyGen tool with updated `exp` date.
3. Restart backend service: sudo docker compose restart server.
backup_and_recovery: Database snapshot: Copy linkpass.db or run pg_dump.
Offline decryption & verification: Use decrypt_backup.py CLI tool to extract and verify backup integrity.
